# ZoneBourse DLB v1.0.0

Initial GitHub release of the Firefox extension already available on [Firefox Add-ons](https://addons.mozilla.org/fr/firefox/addon/zonebourse-dlb/).

- Removes targeted pop-up overlays on ZoneBourse pages.
- Restores page scrolling after removing overlays.
- Detects overlays added after the page loads.

The attached `.xpi` is the version 1.0 package committed to this repository. For routine installation and updates, use the official Firefox Add-ons listing.

**Note:** This project is independent and is not affiliated with ZoneBourse.
